Super Giants Win Maiden Men's Hundred Title

The Manchester Super Giants have won their first Men's Hundred title, defeating the Rockets by 5 runs in the final. Tim Seifert was a key player, scoring 72 runs. Sanjiv Goenka, chairman of the Super Giants, praised the team's effort throughout the tournament.
